Pargat Singh Appointed Punjab Congress Chief

Pargat Singh has been appointed as the new president of the Punjab Congress. This appointment follows the resignation of Amarinder Singh Raja Warring from the position. The decision regarding Pargat Singh's appointment was reportedly changed at the last moment.
